verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only role-based features: organization roles and permissions, admin role management, and an "access control" mention. Community comments likewise describe it as RBAC. Nothing documents relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy/attribute-based, resource-level authorization beyond roles, so this adjacent RBAC capability earns no credit for the story.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can express fine-grained, resource-level authorization (relationship- or policy-based) beyond simple roles
